projects.name: TriviaDuel
projects.description: Real-time multiplayer trivia platform featuring sub-100ms synchronization and resilient multi-model AI question generation.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional trivia platforms suffer from repetitive question pools, latency desync in live player lobbies, and fragile single-point AI rate-limiting during peak quiz generation.
caseStudy.approach: Engineered an edge-synchronized state machine utilizing Redis pub/sub for sub-100ms room synchronization paired with dual-stage optimistic client ticks. Architected a multi-model fallback pipeline (Gemini 2.5 → DeepSeek) with local cached embeddings.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Decoupled real-time WebSocket state from persistent relational schemas by streaming delta patches over compact binary encodings rather than full JSON blobs, slashing mobile network overhead by 68%.
caseStudy.result: Maintained continuous 60fps canvas animations with sub-100ms room consensus across 10 concurrent player nodes and zero question generation downtime during API latency spikes.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Implement WebRTC DataChannels for peer-to-peer audio banter to further minimize central server ingress during large multiplayer tournaments.

projects.name: SecureAsset
projects.description: Forensic digital watermarking and intellectual property protection platform with LiquidGlass UI and cryptographic verification.

caseStudy.problem: Digital artists and enterprises face rampant intellectual property theft where metadata watermarks are trivially stripped by screenshot tools, re-compression, or social media pipelines.
caseStudy.approach: Built a multi-layered forensic embedding pipeline supporting spatial LSB (Least Significant Bit), frequency-domain Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), and cryptographic EXIF payload seals.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Engineered the DCT frequency mask transformations in WebAssembly/Web Workers to keep forensic watermarking instantaneous in-browser without uploading sensitive assets to third-party cloud infrastructure.
caseStudy.result: Watermark survival rates achieved 94% retention against aggressive JPEG re-compression (down to 45% quality) and withstands standard screenshot cropping attempts.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Incorporate deep neural watermarking (implicit neural representations) to extend tamper resilience against generative diffusion inpainting.

projects.name: LumeGlass Portfolio
projects.description: Cinematic dark minimalist portfolio featuring 3D WebGL artifacts, arcane spellbook transitions, and modular bento layout.

caseStudy.problem: Standard developer portfolios are static, template-driven, and lack authentic technical personality, tactile micro-interactions, and cinematic depth.
caseStudy.approach: Crafted the 'Lume-Glass' visual ecosystem combining a 54-pyramid Rubik HexCore in R3F, realistic 3D paper leaf physics with synthesized Web Audio, and an infinite 3D project carousel with inertia physics.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Defined cross-browser CSS masking and compiled Tailwind v4 theme variables to achieve GPU-accelerated neon border beams with zero main thread layout thrashing.
caseStudy.result: Achieved consistent 60fps render loops on mid-range devices while maintaining full keyboard accessibility, zero-JS HTML crawlability, and Supabase JSONB modularity.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Implement custom GLSL post-processing chromatic aberration shaders on carousel drag inertia spikes.

projects.name: 3D Portfolio Website
projects.description: Early exploratory 3D spatial web environment built with raw Three.js and custom camera orbit controls.

caseStudy.problem: Exploration of 3D spatial boundaries and spatial audio integration for web browsers before modern WebGL abstractions became ubiquitous.
caseStudy.approach: Constructed raw Three.js geometry meshes with procedural materials, ambient point light rigs, and custom raycasting click selectors.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Maintained an unbundled, lightweight single-bundle architecture to evaluate raw browser rendering performance without framework overhead.
caseStudy.result: Provided foundational learnings on WebGL matrix transformations, frustum culling, and camera lerp math that informed the current portfolio architecture.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Adopt a declarative component graph (R3F) for more maintainable state synchronization.

projects.name: ePub Novel Sanitizer
projects.description: Automated ePub typography and metadata cleaning pipeline removing translator artifacts and normalizing XHTML semantics.

caseStudy.problem: Downloaded e-books and web novels often feature broken CSS font declarations, messy nested advertising divs, and misaligned chapter hierarchy that ruin e-reader rendering.
caseStudy.approach: Created an automated decompression, AST parsing, and regex sanitization pipeline that purges non-standard tags while preserving valid styling and chapter NCX navigation tables.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Utilized BeautifulSoup with lxml parser for high-throughput DOM tree normalization paired with automated zip archive rebuilding.
caseStudy.result: Batch-processes multi-megabyte ePub archives in under 200ms with 100% W3C ePub validator compliance.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Wrap the core Python engine in a lightweight WebAssembly/Pyodide interface for client-side browser usage.

projects.name: Mario Kart Console
projects.description: Object-oriented terminal simulation of kart racing mechanics, item rolls, and track obstacle algorithms in C#.

caseStudy.problem: Simulate deterministic turn-based arcade racing dynamics within a text-based terminal environment.
caseStudy.approach: Applied OOP patterns (Factory, Strategy, State) to model kart weight classes, terrain speed modifiers, and probabilistic RNG item distribution.
caseStudy.keyTechnicalDecision: Engineered an event-driven tick system that decoupled terminal rendering buffers from game logic evaluation.
caseStudy.result: Delivered an engaging terminal game loop illustrating robust software design patterns and clean architectural separation in C#.
caseStudy.whatIdDoDifferently: Implement ANSI escape sequence terminal color graphics and animated ASCII art sprites.
